sections.title: About this guide
data: Station Grays Harbor is a small-boat station in Westport, which the Coast Guard named its 28th Coast Guard City. The home count comes from the Coast Guard's housing map; the station facts come from an undated Coast Guard fact sheet read through search results.
Ask your sponsor before you move.

sections.title: Coast Guard Housing
data: The Coast Guard's housing map lists 17 active homes at the Grays Harbor housing site.

In the Coast Guard, assignment to Coast Guard housing is generally mandatory when a home is available, and BAH starts only after the housing office releases you to rent in town. Ask your sponsor for the local housing officer before you look at rentals.
